name: Dashboard Overview — Sharp Glassmorphism
description: Frosted-glass analytics dashboard overview floating over a living animated gradient mesh. Translucent KPI stat cards with trend deltas, a pure-SVG area + line chart, a recent-activity feed, and a wired 7d/30d/90d range selector that swaps hardcoded datasets live. Luminous edges and a gradient primary accent.
features: KPI stat cards with trend deltas
pure SVG area + line chart (no libraries)
live dataset swap on range change
